title: Chamath Palihapitiya on rebuilding Social Capital & Silicon Valley ponzi scheme
summary: Chamath Palihapitiya talks with Jason Calacanis about how he bought into the mythology of Silicon Valley, which he calls a Ponzi scheme, and about rebuilding Social Capital. He urges founders to grow slowly and build what matters.
why: HN cites it for Chamath's claim that venture-backed growth resembles a Ponzi scheme, especially when startups spend heavily on big-tech advertising.

quote.text: I really liked this video featuring Chamath Palihapitiya[1].
